name: ce.debug_events
description: Page debugger events using generation-bound event-sequence cursors. Reuse nextCursor even when truncated is false to poll for new events. droppedEvents reports a retention gap after the requested cursor; a rolling buffer is not a complete execution history. Events alone do not prove the target is still stopped; inspect current debugger status before using stopGeneration.

cursor.description: Use nextCursor unchanged, not a numeric ring index. It identifies the last delivered event in this generation; inspect droppedEvents for a rollover gap.
